A broad black-ink main paragraph fills the upper roughly four fifths; it includes two inline formulas, three correction sites and five red underline spans. A separate large sentence fragment about combinatorial topology follows. Below it is a smaller, lighter parenthetical continuation direction, then a four-line smaller final paragraph with a relocated word and a sixth red underline. The left lower corner carries pencil archive number 10; there is no manuscript page number, heading, date, display, diagram, drawing, letterhead or stamp. The inventory separately covers every text block, inline formula, insertion, deletion and underline. Different ink/size does not by itself establish a different writer.

notes: The continuing paragraph proposes a tame topological setting for shape and form, with particular mention of homotopy types of homeomorphism and imbedding spaces and a comprehensive dévissage theory for stratified structures.

The second continent is described as bringing several mathematical subjects together around the action of absolute Galois groups on anabelian profinite geometrical fundamental groups. The page supplies the Gal and pi examples transcribed above; no exponent 1 is written on P.

The separate sentence begins One of the leading threads comes from the combinatorial topology and ends there without a stop. The next line is the literal direction (Continues without change until last paragraph), not an indication of text omitted from this reading.

The last paragraph refers to the two first volumes of Pursuing Stacks, says that their English correspondence impetus led to writing them in English, and describes a substantial common introduction whose first part is personal rather than technical and is in French, called the author's adopted language.

The prose opening parenthesis before the pi example is left unmatched; the last paragraph has no comma after English and ends language.). as written. Archive sheet number 10 appears only in the comment.

brief_feedback: The whole image and each supplied half were viewed exactly once. Seven unresolved loci were listed before cropping; each generated crop was displayed once in a group of at most two. No OCR, extraction, web lookup, other page, other reader output or subagent was used. H contains only a status note, not a note preserving its flattened interlineations. I counted H guillemet shapes as meaningful differences from the ink, while treating emph/uline, struck/deleted, bar/overline, operatorname/mathrm and ellipsis encoding as syntax when their content/state agreed. The two uncertainty states retained in reading.tex concern buried letters, not the clearly visible deletion extents or the live two placement. Parenthesis parsing was used for transcription only; no mathematically substantive theorem check was performed, so math_checks is empty.
